findings.title: Persistence requires soundness
findings.claim: The context supplies a counterexample that makes longevity value-neutral: coverings over hearts, weight in ears, and never-ending non-guidance persist, while the focus calls only enduring sound things better.
findings.mechanism: The focus joins persistence to ṣāliḥāt, whereas 18:57 joins durable obstruction to a condition that continues ever. The contact turns soundness into the quality-control term that distinguishes valuable persistence from mere duration.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees why the adjective qualifying what remains matters: duration alone cannot carry the verse's better verdict.
findings.containment: The attributed contextual counterexample preserves the ordinary adverbial force of the duration term and does not claim that every use of persistence is morally defective. The non-focus branches are unresolved and remain without invented glosses.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus and 18:57 anchors and HFT changed reading support the contrast, while the context branch registry and morphology are explicitly limited.

branch_activations.carrier: The context's ever-continuing duration carries the long persistence of the blocked condition.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus restricts the better enduring category by soundness.
branch_activations.activation: Long duration contacts the persistence and soundness carriers by supplying a durable counterexample that lacks the focus's quality condition.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Bare longevity is value-neutral; the better remainder is duration joined to soundness.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch registry is unresolved, so only the exact HFT duration role is retained.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şey yok olmaz; varlığı veya içinde bulunduğu durum sürer.

branch_activations.activation: The focus persistence contacts the durable obstruction sequence and becomes distinguishable from it through the soundness qualifier.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The verse values not whatever persists, but what persists as sound and rightly ordered.
branch_activations.boundary: The activation uses the general persistence facet and does not activate remaining-piece, preservation, or watching senses.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: Soundness is indispensable to the value of what remains.

findings.title: Return can be imagined as protective covering
findings.claim: Exploratorily, the focus's outward adornment is counter-imaged by a return shaped as protective covering: what sound acts bring back, with forgiveness, can be imagined as something that covers the self rather than only an abstract payment.
findings.mechanism: The focus places adornment beside the return/recompense carrier, while 18:58 supplies forgiving protection. The supplied garment branch of ث و ب contacts the return movement and gives the recompense a material covering image.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader gains a concrete way to perceive the difference between outward display and what returns through action: one adorns from outside, the other can be imagined as covering what is being evaluated.
findings.containment: This is an explicitly exploratory root-level material wordplay. It does not claim that ثَوَابًا lexically means garment in this occurrence, and it does not replace the ordinary reward reading; the unresolved forgiveness branch remains attributed.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus and 18:58 anchors and HFT outlier trace provide a specific contact and changed image, but the relation is surprising, legacy-unbound, and partly unresolved.

branch_activations.activation: The return carrier contacts adornment and forgiveness, allowing recompense to be imagined as a returned protective function.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The better return can be pictured as what comes back through action and covers the evaluated self.
branch_activations.boundary: The ordinary return/recompense facet remains primary in this activation; the garment image is an attributed exploratory extension.

findings.title: Lineage can be seen as built continuity
findings.claim: Exploratorily, sons carry both literal lineage and a human-built continuity/support image: the focus's movable construction is contrasted with sound acts whose persistence does not depend on descendants carrying the load.
findings.mechanism: The focus's literal sonship carrier contacts the building and load-bearing branches of the same source family; removed terrain in 18:47 and denied strengthening help in 18:51 provide independent triggers. The contact turns biological continuity into a bounded structural metaphor.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive why the verse's contrast reaches beyond duration: descendants may represent a built line of continuity, while the enduring sound remainder is not dependent on that structure remaining in place.
findings.containment: This is an explicitly exploratory structural metaphor, not a translation of بنون and not a replacement for literal sons. The unresolved terrain and helper branches remain attributed, and the metaphor is limited to continuity/support pressure.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus and context anchors and outlier trace provide distinct carrier/trigger contacts, but the structural extension is surprising and several context branch records are unresolved.

findings.title: The Lord-centered verdict opens to a universal standpoint
findings.claim: The explicitly added 1:2 gives the focus's phrase 'at your Lord' a bounded universal overlay: the evaluative standpoint is connected to the Lord named as Lord of the worlds, not treated as a private human preference.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier 18:46:10:1 names the Lord at whose standpoint reward and hope are evaluated; external 1:2 independently repeats the same root in the phrase joining the Lord to all worlds. The shared carrier/trigger contact broadens the scale of the verdict while leaving the focus comparison intact.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive the value comparison as standing under a universal governing authority, which explains why the focus's better verdict is not merely a personal taste about possessions.
findings.containment: This is the only retained external overlay. It does not import the whole Fātiḥa argument, add an independent judgment scene, or erase the focus's personal address; 1:3-1:7 supplied no further focus-returning delta beyond native/pericope findings.

epistemic.reason: The packet supplies the exact external occurrence, the exact focus carrier, and the focus branch record, but no separate citable support trust label for this uncandidate overlay; the result is therefore bounded and qualified.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The better return and hope are evaluated under a Lord whose governing standpoint encompasses the worlds.
branch_activations.boundary: The overlay preserves the focus's Lord-centered value comparison and does not claim that every external Fātiḥa theme is activated here.
